cover.learning_purpose: Identify the lesson and its central decision at a glance.
cover.title: AA07 · Human Approval & Guardrails · cover
cover.caption: Identify the lesson and its central decision at a glance. Place approval before consequential side effects and recheck its scope.
cover.alt_text: A person holds an approval gate around a narrow proposal while a wider changed proposal waits outside its scope.
cover.extended_description:
Place approval before consequential side effects and recheck its scope.

An organizer approves a message for 20 recipients. If the agent changes the recipient list to 200, the old approval is insufficient. Bind approval to the reviewed proposal and require another decision.

A materially changed proposal needs fresh approval before any consequential side effect.
cover.generation_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. BTG AI lesson identity cover, 16:9 high-resolution editorial illustration. Premium contemporary academic illustration, dark indigo #141724, restrained violet and cyan, subtle paper texture, flat forms with modest depth. One dominant metaphor and one secondary contextual element. No text, numbers, logos, diagram boxes, arrows, fake dashboards, brains, robots, neon or stock imagery. Keep essential subject inside central 40% width and central 65% height, generous title-safe negative space, safe center crops to 4:5 and 1:1. This is cover art, not an explanatory diagram. Lesson: Human Approval & Guardrails. Objective: bind approval to exact proposal and recheck scope before side effects. Canonical example: changing a message's recipients from 20 to 200 invalidates prior approval. Dominant metaphor: an adjustable aperture gate held by a human hand at a paused decision point; a narrow paper ribbon fits its approved opening while a visibly wider folded ribbon waits beside it. Secondary element: a blank approval seal lying unused. No checkmark suggesting the wider proposal is approved. Natural dark skin hand, contemporary university technology context, no ethnic motifs.
